stem_book: Rutherford found that about one in 20,000 α-particles was deflected back through angles > 90°. Which statement agrees with this observation? (a) A very heavy and dense body exists in the atom occupying a small volume. (b) Positive charge is uniformly spread throughout the atom. (c) Back-scattering occurs due to electrons. (d) α-Particles convert into protons on collision.
key: a A heavy, dense body occupying a small volume exists in the atom
derived: a A very heavy and dense body exists in the atom occupying a small volume
correct_answer: a A very heavy and dense body exists in the atom occupying a small volume
work: Rare >90° rebound needs a tiny, massive, positive centre (nucleus); electrons too light to reverse α
